decision: Keep the bulk-vector direction as a candidate, not a new default. Preserve the existing four default features and original PGO.
16/64/127-dimensional large-output query phases improve, but filter60k and other protection cases have negative observations. Positive cases do not cancel these negatives.

The short-circuit did not remove protection regressions. Code-generation review identifies an outlined predicate called twice for the two30k projections. Its contribution to the full slowdown is not established.
Test an explicit admission loop with equivalent conditions using the same192-pair protocol. Keep the default off. Do not modify or remove this run samples.
limitations: Source baseline is delivered e020, independently rebuilt with original PGO and four flags. A newly constructed build image does not imply different executable bytes; explicit SHA equality is reported.
Bulk candidate enables only MVDB_TYPED_BULK_VECTOR_ONLY on top of the original four flags. Candidate-source and independently trained profile/layout effects are part of this contrast.
Every candidate scenario has15 paired runs over3 fixed seeds; AA scenarios have6 runs. These are repeated process runs, not15 independent workloads or independent PGO builds.
Fifteen-pair bootstrap is predeclared secondary, stratified within fixed seeds, not a general confidence guarantee.
No cohort-wide speedup is computed from differently weighted scenarios. Every negative pair and order/seed subgroup remains.
Projection accounted totals include ingestion and all query timers, excluding oracle/untimed setup. Process counters are not official cgroup scores.
Source/profile manifests and retained binaries are audited; this analysis does not rebuild/execute them or replay every stored-value oracle.
Performance covers16,64,127 bulk dimensions and128,768 preservation screens; correctness boundaries do not prove benefits for unmeasured dimensions, WHERE predicates or every table size.
Formal competition submission is prohibited; this tool cannot submit or change production switches.
The independent analysis includes projection proc CPU, RSS/HWM and I/O snapshots. These are coarse process proxies, not cgroup scores, independent per-phase memory peaks or physical-device I/O.
Projection repeats within one pair are not independent experiments. All query first requests, later requests, startup/ingestion pauses and negative pairs remain in the complete raw archive.
30k does not project a vector. Its slowdown remains negative across all seeds and both orders. Source/layout and host effects are not fully causally separated.
The default root-image correctness proof is separate. Performance evidence applies only to the exact program hashes listed here.
